summary: Sysco Corporation and co-registrant Sysco Holdings Corporation issued C$750 million of 4.250% senior notes due 2030 and C$750 million of 4.800% senior notes due 2034, a C$1.5 billion aggregate Canadian-dollar offering priced September 25, 2026, under an automatically effective Form S-3ASR shelf filed September 14, 2026. Notes are guaranteed by the named guarantors and issued under a base indenture plus first supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Net proceeds approximated C$1.49 billion. This is routine debt capital markets activity, not a special situation; watch for proceeds deployment and leverage commentary.
